svg.title: Winter heat lines already cited
svg.desc: Minnesota says supplemental heat below 35 degrees Fahrenheit. This site's planner turns adult watts on only below 20 degrees Fahrenheit. Maryland says dry, wind-protected adults should not need additional heat.

g.text: Three heat statements, not one scale
Supplemental heat when the coop falls below 35°F
Dry, wind-protected adults should not need additional heat
Adult watts only below 20°F  site planning, not those pages
